title: nemotron-halloween
hook_text: Nvidia built an AI haunted house.
script:
Nvidia built an interactive haunted house powered by Nemotron open models.
Engineers combined vision capabilities and language models to create live responses.
Sensors and cameras track visitors in real time as they walk through the dark corridors.
The Hugging Face blog outlines how the team deployed custom workflows for the project.
This setup shows how edge computing can run complex neural networks locally.
Would you walk through an AI haunted house?
